craft_notes: Sthāyin: seal-by-citation (image-abandoning first). Rows: row 2 (holds→taught). Close: taught (vakṣyate as landing: the pointer forward). Rejected: naming the next āhnika — kept occasional (naimittika as the verse's own pointer, not our table of contents).

lines: Everywhere here the śrāddha rule: image-abandoning first —
Siddhāmata so holds; its rule to be told where the occasional is taught.
l4.sanskrit_cite: sarvatra ca atra śrāddhādividhau mūrtiyāgaḥ pradhānam iti śrīsiddhāmatam tadvidhiś ca vakṣyate naimittikaprakāśane
